changes: FUNC + TUN now offers 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12 and 16 bars, so loops of 3 beats or 1.5 bars sync too; AUTO still picks 1/4 to 16 in powers of two.
FUNC + FIN corrects by up to 25 % in 0.2 % steps.

Mode and correction are kept per sample with the project (up to 51 samples); a SMP-locked loop without its own setting plays at the sound's loop speed if it is a copy, else in AUTO; FUNC + TUN/FIN always set the sound's loop.
A loop that needs more than TUN's range no longer jumps back to full speed: it stays as slow or fast as TUN goes.
Settings saved with 0.2 are not read: set your loops again once.
First library release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74 on core-ar2 0.3: keeps sample loops in time with the project tempo by repitching them.
AUTO reads each loop's tempo from its length, SMP locks and scenes included; FUNC + FIN corrects each sample slot in percent.
Trailing digital silence is left out and the pitch glides on tempo changes. Pitch follows tempo: there is no time-stretch.
Not yet tested on a unit: this exact build, saving and reboots, external MIDI clock and CPU load.
